description: Traps, poisons and hard-won instinct - the hunter who comes home.

nodes.name: Improved Tracking
nodes.description: Increases all your damage by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids and Undead, all damage done to those targets is increased by 1%-5%.' DEPARTURE - NOTHING in this engine reads a creature type, and there is no tracking state either. Delivered unconditionally at the real per-rank value, which in practice is what the real talent amounts to once you are tracking the right thing. The outgoing version was Serpent Sting damage.

nodes.name: Surefooted
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the duration of movement impairing effects by 10%/20%/30%.' DEPARTURE - there is no movement impairment at all, and the three CoA talents authored as dispel_type 'movement' were found to remove nothing, because that is not a real DispelType. Sure footing becomes accuracy. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Survivalist
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases your Stamina by 2%-10%.' stamina_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS. The outgoing version granted max_health_pct, which is downstream of Stamina rather than the talent - and the distinction matters here, because Hunter vs. Wild converts STAMINA into attack power. It is Hunter vs. Wild's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Entrapment
nodes.description: Your traps have a 20% chance per rank to hold the target fast for 1 turn.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'When your Frost Trap or Snake Trap are triggered you entrap all afflicted targets, preventing them from moving for 4 sec.' DEPARTURE - neither named trap exists, and 'when triggered' has no event (nothing fires on a trap being sprung). It fires on the trap being CAST instead, against the two traps we have. Preventing movement becomes is_stun, this engine's only incapacitate. The outgoing version extended Freezing Trap's duration.

nodes.name: Trap Mastery
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Explosive Trap by 10% per rank and the duration of your Freezing Trap by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim for the two traps that exist: 'Frost Trap and Freezing Trap - Increases the duration by 10%/20%/30%. Immolation Trap, Explosive Trap and Black Arrow - increases the damage.' Kept from the outgoing tree, which covered Explosive Trap alone.

nodes.name: Deflection
nodes.description: Increases your parry chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases your chance to parry by 1%/2%/3%, and reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you.' The parry half is verbatim; Disarm duration is not modifiable. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 5 ranks to the real 3. It is Counterattack's prerequisite in the real tree; Counterattack does not exist here.

nodes.name: Survival Instincts
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 2% per rank and increases the critical chance of your shots by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim with both halves: 'Reduces all damage taken by 2%/4% and increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane Shot, Steady Shot and Explosive Shot by 2%/4%.' damage_taken_pct is read RAW on both sides. The outgoing version used low_health_damage_reduction_pct AND low_health_threshold_pct, which is Fiery Payback's shape and put this class one node from a summing-threshold breach.

nodes.name: Hunter vs. Wild
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 10% of your Stamina per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim: 'Increases you and your pet's attack power and ranged attack power equal to 10%-30% of your total Stamina.' A REAL stat conversion - attack_power is a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET and stamina a valid source. MEASURED LIVE at +14 attack power, so the key is a RAW MULTIPLIER and not a percentage (character.py:1551). The pet half cannot be built - a talent effect cannot reach the pet, which reads only pet_damage/health/armor from its owner. The real talent requires Survivalist, which connected_to reproduces and which is the Stamina that feeds this. The outgoing node was a proc with an empty effects dict.

nodes.name: T.N.T
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Explosive Trap, Explosive Shot and Black Arrow by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree, built verbatim for the three real abilities that exist: 'Increases the damage done by your Explosive Shot, Explosive Trap, Black Arrow and Immolation Trap by 5%/10%/15%.' Stacks with Trap Mastery on Explosive Trap, as the real pair does.

nodes.name: Killer Instinct
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim: 'Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%/2%/3%.' The outgoing version granted per-ability crit. It is Wyvern Sting's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Lock and Load
nodes.description: Your traps have a 33% chance per rank to reset the cooldown of your Explosive Shot.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'You have a 100% chance when you trap a target with Freezing Trap, Freezing Arrow or Frost Trap to generate 2 charges of Lock and Load, causing your next 2 Explosive Shots to cost no mana and trigger no cooldown.' Built with the real spirit via reset_cooldown, a real proc payload (status_effects.py:1207), fired off the traps we have. Charges do not exist and 'when you trap a target' has no event, so it fires on the cast. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Lightning Reflexes
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases your Agility by 3%-15%.' agility_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS and flows into both ranged and melee attack power, so this is the tree's broadest offensive node. It is Expose Weakness's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Resourcefulness
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your traps and Black Arrow by 20% per rank and their cooldown by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Reduces the mana cost of all traps, melee abilities and Black Arrow by 20%-60% and reduces the cooldown.' There are no melee abilities in this kit to cover. Kept from the outgoing tree, which used the FLAT _cost key.

nodes.name: Expose Weakness
nodes.description: Your critical strikes raise your attack power for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Your ranged criticals have a 100% chance to grant you Expose Weakness, increasing your attack power by an amount equal to 10%-30% of your Agility for 7 sec.' Built on the real trigger. Scaling a PROC's payload from a stat is not possible - stat conversions are a talent-effect mechanism, not a payload one - so attack_power 120 is flat. attack_power inside a status effect is FLAT and is summed from active effects like any gear bonus. The real talent requires Lightning Reflexes, reproduced. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Master Tactician
nodes.description: Your shots have a 10% chance to raise your critical strike chance by 2% per rank for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Your successful ranged attacks have a 10% chance to increase your critical strike chance with all attacks by 2%-10% for 8 sec.' Built with the real 10% trigger chance - note the chance is NOT rank-scaled here, because the real talent scales its MAGNITUDE and a proc's payload cannot scale with points. So the payload carries the full 10% and the chance stays at the real flat 10%. 8 seconds is 3 turns. The outgoing node was a 1-point proc.

nodes.name: Wyvern Sting
nodes.description: Teaches Wyvern Sting, a shot that puts the target to sleep.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for hunter_wyvern_sting, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Killer Instinct, which connected_to reproduces. It is Noxious Stings' prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Noxious Stings
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting and Wyvern Sting by 5% per rank, and reduces your Wyvern Sting cooldown by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'If Wyvern Sting is dispelled, the dispeller is also afflicted by Wyvern Sting, and increases all damage done by your Stings by 5%/10%/15%.' There is no dispel trigger, so only the damage half is built - verbatim, across both real Stings. The real talent requires Wyvern Sting, reproduced. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Thrill of the Hunt
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to restore 150 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Gives you a 33%-100% chance to regain 40% of the mana cost of any shot when it critically hits.' Built with the real chance curve on the real trigger. A refund proportional to the shot's cost is not available - grant_resource takes a FLAT amount with no pct_max - so 150 stands in. It is Hunting Party's prerequisite, preserved below. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Point of No Escape
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the critical strike chance of all of your attacks on targets affected by your Frost Trap, Freezing Trap or Freezing Arrow by 3%/6%.' DEPARTURE - NOTHING in this engine reads a debuff on the target, so 'affected by your trap' cannot be checked. Delivered unconditionally at a smaller value, since it is now always on rather than situational.

nodes.name: Black Arrow
nodes.description: Teaches Black Arrow, a shadow-fletched shot that weakens its target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, kept - the ONLY unlock for hunter_black_arrow, which is requires_talent. It is Explosive Shot's prerequisite, preserved below. Moved from tier 4 to its real row.

nodes.name: Hunting Party
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 1% per rank and your haste by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases your total Agility by an additional 1%/2%/3%, and your Arcane Shot, Explosive Shot and Steady Shot critical strikes have a chance to grant party and raid members 3% melee and ranged haste.' The Agility half is verbatim; the party-haste half cannot reach an ally, so the haste applies to the hunter. The real talent requires Thrill of the Hunt, reproduced. The outgoing node was a proc with an empty effects dict.

nodes.name: Sniper Training
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Aimed Shot by 5% per rank and its damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Kill Shot ability by 5%/10%/15%, and while standing still for 6 seconds increases the damage of your Steady Shot.' Kill Shot does not exist and there is no standing-still state, so both clauses land on Aimed Shot, the tree's remaining heavy shot. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Explosive Shot
nodes.description: Teaches Explosive Shot, firing a charge that detonates inside the target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for hunter_explosive_shot, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Black Arrow, which connected_to reproduces.
